ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Secondary Level. This course is for those students registered in the sciences, math, social studies, and history certification programs. NOTE: You are required to take SPED 205, Section B, CRN 53210, which meets during the first 5 weeks of the term (August 24 to September 26). SPED 405, Section S2, CRN 35776, will meet during the final 10 weeks of the semester (September 27 to December 5).
